CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2658 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6. Bus nonce: 4133f907f66d9480b096cf29e7ed0bc2. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6` or `Fix review: blocked f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4133f907f66d9480b096cf29e7ed0bc2`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2658 f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2658-4133f907`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2658 (P2b-pre, step 11a of group R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2), head f8c05fbf7e1ddaf4d15652b88cd40b77372df0f6. Read the group with jq from origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

Context: P2b's governance jobs run the grader programs from the BASE commit (decision 0013), so main's linter judges P2b's tree. That made policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script red by construction on P2b. This PR lands the reader half on main first.

Verify:
(1) (a) counts.mjs cutoverDrift, used by policy_lint requiredContextsOverTree and field_coverage RULESET_PROBE. required-contexts.json gains pre_cutover equal to the live 17 required contexts (read the ruleset once: gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/rulesets/23698884). Show policy-docs green at this head. Mutate cutoverDrift (accept a half-migrated shape) and show red. A record that is neither whole shape must be refused.
(2) (b) agreement_py governance_jobs tolerates a listed governance file the tree lacks, with a failing test first, and an entities pin that keeps a stale _GOV_FILES list from passing silently. Mutate the tolerance and the pin, and show each red.
(3) (c) the ghapi GET retries a 5xx twice with backoff. 4xx and rate limits stay unchanged. Plant 502 then 200 = PASS. Null: a 404 is not retried. Plus a mutant. Check the retry cannot hide a persistent 5xx (it still FAILs after the retries).
(4) THE KEY CLAIM: simulate base-pinned grading of P2b. With this PR's graders as the base, run policy-docs, env-matrix and wave-script against the P2b assembly tree (origin/handoff/r10-ci-layout-p2-* — ask nothing, list the refs and use the newest assembly). Show them green, or name what stays red.
(5) Main stays green: the scoped gate MODE line, plus CI read with one bulk check-runs read. Check ## Red checks answers the first-push pr-contract red. No footers in commits. VERSION untouched.
